row.title: A done check that greps an append-only ledger passes forever
row.body: The sweep items' done check included trailing prose after the regex, so it could never match; and a grep on answers.jsonl or closed.jsonl would keep passing after a relapse. Done checks for clocks must be commands that re-measure (blindspots --closed, --swept, --renewed).

title: A done check that greps an append-only ledger passes forever
